events.title: 에버턴 manager Mike Walker looks to pull his side together by making a triple loan bid for 레인저스 striker Duncan Ferguson and midfielder Ian Durrant as well as Trevor Steven , who was sold from 에버턴 to 레인저스 by Colin Harvey in 1989. On the same day, 에버턴 lose 2–0 to 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford and remain bottom of the Premier League. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 maintain their lead of the Premier League with a 2–0 win at 애스턴 빌라. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 미들즈브러 continue their duel at the top of Division One.

Duncan Ferguson and Ian Durrant complete their loan moves from 레인저스 to 에버턴, but Trevor Steven's move falls through. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 climb out of the bottom four with a 2–1 win at 첼시. 노팅엄 포리스트 climb back into second place and are two points behind 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 after beating QPR 3–2 at the City Ground . The only Division One action of the day sees 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 lose 4–1 to Stoke at the Victoria Ground .
Two local rivals scrapping for points to climb out of the relegation zone meet at Filbert Street , with hosts 레스터 시티 holding Coventry to a 2–2 draw.

In the second legs of the second round League Cup ties, 맨스필드 타운 of Division Three eliminate Premier League high-flyers 리즈 유나이티드, while extra-time goals from Chris Armstrong and Bruce Dyer help top-flight 크리스털 팰리스 see off the challenge of 링컨 시티 , also of the fourth tier.

노팅엄 포리스트 miss the chance to go top of the Premier League when 맨체스터 시티 hold them to a 3–3 draw in a thrilling clash at Maine Road . 리버풀 climb into third place with a 3–2 home win over 애스턴 빌라. 맨체스터 유나이티드's hopes of a third successive Premier League title are hit by a 1–0 defeat at 셰필드 웬즈데이, with David Hirst scoring the only goal of the game.

Division Three side 노샘프턴 타운 move into the new Sixfields Stadium . Their first game is against 바닛 , ending in a 1–1 draw with 19-year-old striker Martin Aldridge scoring the first goal at the new stadium. In the Premier League, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 win 1–0 at 크리스털 팰리스 to make it 10 matches unbeaten and maintain their lead of the league. 블랙번 로버스 keep up the pressure with a 3–2 home win over 리버풀. 맨체스터 유나이티드 bounce back from their disappointment last weekend to beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 1–0 at Old Trafford with a goal from Eric Cantona . 레스터 시티's hopes of surviving their first season in the Premier League are given a major boost when they beat 사우샘프턴 4–3 at home to climb out of the bottom four. 미들즈브러 suffer a shock 5–1 defeat at Luton in Division One, which pushes them down from second to fourth place, but sees their hosts make a dramatic surge from 18th place to eighth. A thrilling game at Fratton Park sees 포츠머스 beat 스윈던 타운 4–3.

Keith Burkinshaw , at 59 the oldest manager in the English league, is sacked by Division One strugglers 웨스트브로미치 앨비언. 노팅엄 포리스트 climb back into second place in the Premier League with a 3–1 home win over 윔블던 putting them two points behind leaders 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.
A late equaliser from Lee Sharpe preserves 맨체스터 유나이티드's 38-year unbeaten run in European competitions as they hold 바르셀로나 to a 2–2 draw in their third Champions League group fixture at Old Trafford.

An exciting weekend in the Premier League and Football League kicks off. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 maintain their lead of the Premier League and take their unbeaten start to 11 matches with a 2–1 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이, although 노팅엄 포리스트 keep the gap down to two points with a 2–0 win at 애스턴 빌라. 노리치 시티 maintain their hold on sixth place with a 4–2 home win over QPR, while 맨체스터 시티's 5–2 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼 takes them onto the brink of the top five and the chance of European football for the first time since the late 1970s. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 maintain their lead of Division One with a 3–3 draw at home to struggling 밀월 , as their nearest rivals Reading and Tranmere are both beaten.
Title contenders 블랙번 로버스 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 clash in the league at Ewood Park , with 알렉스 퍼거슨 's side finishing 4–2 winners.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드's unbeaten start to the Premier League season ends with a 2–0 defeat to 맨체스터 유나이티드, although they remain top of the table thanks to 노팅엄 포리스트's 2–0 defeat at home to fourth-placed 블랙풀. A mere five points separate the top four teams, with 리버풀 muscling in on the leading pack with a 3–1 win at 입스위치 타운. While 리버풀 are showings signs of turning into serious title contenders for the first time in four seasons, 에버턴 are held to a 1–1 draw at home to 아스널 and are still bottom of the Premier League and winless after 12 games.

October draws to a close with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 still top, with 노팅엄 포리스트, 맨체스터 유나이티드, 블랙번 로버스, 리버풀 and 리즈 유나이티드 their nearest contenders. 에버턴 are still bottom of the league and it currently looks like something little short of a miracle will save their 41-year top flight tenure as they have yet to win a league game after their opening 12 games. 레스터 시티, 윔블던 and 입스위치 타운 have also joined 에버턴 in the relegation zone. 리버풀 miss the chance of going third with a 2–1 defeat at QPR. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 미들즈브러 remain level at the top of Division One, with 트랜미어 로버스, Reading and 스윈던 타운 complete the top five. 밀월 have taken 번리's place in the Division One relegation zone, which is otherwise unchanged.
